messages:
Alex Kim: Quick sync — we're migrating the Optimize toolkit sample code from sync SDK calls to the v2 async/streaming patterns. Need docs updates, snippets, and a short migration checklist.
Maya Patel: Which pages/paths are affected?
Alex Kim: Mainly docs/optkit/samples.md and the examples repo under github.com/redwood-inference/examples/optkit. Also any crosslinks from the quantization guide.
Keegan O'Rourke: I can convert the code snippets to async. Do we prefer explicit streaming examples or the simpler `await client.generate()` pattern?
Alex Kim: Prefer streaming for the main example — shows incremental output & KV cache benefits. Keep a short non-streaming example too. Use `client.stream_generate()` for py and `client.streamGenerate()` for JS.
Samira Gupta: I'll draft the migration checklist copy. Note: caching semantics changed slightly in v2 — we should call out `cache_policy: 'auto'` as default and removal of legacy flags.
Keegan O'Rourke: Opening PR with python + js streaming snippets now. PR title: "optkit: async stream samples + migration notes" — linking in thread.
docs-bot: PR opened: #3421 by keegan — CI: lint failed (pyfmt)
Keegan O'Rourke: fixing formatting; small var rename in python example (`stream_to_console` -> `stream_to_console_async`).
Maya Patel: Also found a broken internal link: docs/optkit/quant -> should point to docs/optimize/quantization/profiles. I'll add a quick patch.
Alex Kim: Good catch. Also add a tiny bench snippet showing cost/latency tradeoffs for batching vs streaming. That helps customers choose defaults.
Samira Gupta: I'll add a microbenchmark script and a short results blurb. Example command to run locally: ```python -m examples.optkit.bench --batch-size 8 --seq-len 128 --model redwood-7b```
Maya Patel: Once Keegan's PR passes CI, can someone from eng-qa run samples smoke tests? Tagging @eng-qa.
Keegan O'Rourke: pushed fix, CI green except a flaky samples e2e on macos runner — rerunning.
Maya Patel: Reran tests, e2e passed this time. I'll merge after docs spellcheck.
Samira Gupta: Migration checklist draft snippet (for docs): - rename sync snippets to async streaming
- update crosslinks to new quantization profiles path
- replace `--use-prefix-cache` flag usage with `cache_policy: 'auto'` 
- add note about batching impact on token-cost (see bench results)
Keegan O'Rourke: Added comments in PR asking for a one-line explanation above each snippet about when to prefer streaming vs batched synchronous calls.
Alex Kim: Perfect. After merge I'll add a one-line release note to the docs changelog and tag developer newsletter. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: I'll follow up with a tiny PR to fix the last two internal links in the guide.
Alex Kim: Thank you — action owners: Keegan (PR merge + snippet comments), Samira (bench + checklist), Maya (link fixes + merge), Alex (changelog + newsletter).
Samira Gupta: One more: update the example's config example to use `quant_profile: "balanced_latency"` in the samples — avoids misleading default perf numbers.
Keegan O'Rourke: Updated sample config in PR.
Maya Patel: Merged main PR and created follow-up link-fix PR #3438.
Alex Kim: Closing thread once link PR is merged and changelog added. Thanks all!
